title: Backend Learning Plan
content: Piyush aims to understand the rationale behind choosing one technology over another, not just how to use them. He is following a structured weekly, daily study method, with caching as the initial topic.
raw_text:
- Wants depth: to explain why one technology or approach beats another, not just use it
